hub.title: Approval workflows
hub.delegations: Let someone decide your approvals while you are away.
hub.escalations: Requests that waited too long and moved up a level.
hub.rules: Who approves what, in which order, and when it escalates.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this. (ref {requestId})
errors.ESCALATION_BLOCKED: You cannot route a stage to yourself, a role you hold or a permission you hold. Ask an owner. (ref {requestId})
errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only an owner can create or change a rule that approves automatically, or change a rule checked before one. (ref {requestId})
errors.SELF_GRANT_FORBIDDEN: You cannot delegate someone else's approvals to yourself. (ref {requestId})
errors.NOT_FOUND: It no longer exists or you cannot see it. (ref {requestId})
errors.VALIDATION: Please check the highlighted values and try again. (ref {requestId})
errors.INVALID_CONDITION: The condition is not valid: check each field name, operator and value. (ref {requestId})
errors.CATCH_ALL_REQUIRED: Every workflow must keep one rule without a condition, so that every request finds a rule. (ref {requestId})
errors.RULE_IN_USE: Requests on this rule are still pending. Decide or cancel them before removing a stage. (ref {requestId})
errors.DUPLICATE: That already exists (same priority, or an overlapping delegation to the same person). (ref {requestId})
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Please give a reason (at least 3 characters). (ref {requestId})
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is not reachable. Try again in a moment. (ref {requestId})

condition.hint: All filled rows must hold. Leave every row empty for "always". Field names come from the request, e.g. amount or order.total. Lists are comma-separated.

stage.permissionHint: Approval limits (e.g. maximum %) come from the role that grants this permission.
stage.requiredHint: Distinct people. One for a named person or the requester's manager.
stage.fallbackNone: The approver's manager (owners if there is none)
stage.fallbackHint: Used for the first escalation; later levels go to that person's manager.
stage.removeHint: Removing a stage is refused while requests on this rule are pending.
stage.label: Stage {no}

rule.priorityHint: Lower numbers are checked first; the first rule whose condition holds decides the stages.
rule.autoApprove: Approve automatically when this rule matches (owner only)
rule.ownerOnlyEdit: This rule approves automatically. Only an owner can change it.
rule.firstStageHint: A new rule needs at least one stage. Add more stages after saving.
rule.title: Rule · priority {priority}
rule.autoApproveNote: Approved automatically; stages are not used
rule.notEditable: This condition uses a form the editor cannot show. Saving replaces it with the rows below.
rule.newHint: Use a condition to send some requests (e.g. larger amounts) to different approvers.

rules.title: Approval rules
rules.subtitle: Each workflow checks its rules by priority; the first matching rule decides who approves.
rules.howItWorks: Every change is recorded with its reason and reported to the owners.
rules.readOnly: You can read these rules. Changing them needs the workflow configuration permission.
rules.limitsNote: Approval limits are set on roles (Roles page). Conditions here decide which approvers a request needs.
rules.noRules: This workflow has no rules yet.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.subtitle: While a delegation is active, the delegate can decide the delegator's approvals. Nobody can approve their own request, a request about themselves, or two stages of one request.
delegations.emptyFromMe: You have not delegated your approvals.
delegations.emptyToMe: Nobody has delegated approvals to you.

form.title: New delegation
form.hint: For holidays and other absences. At most 90 days.
form.windowHint: Cairo time. A start in the past starts now.

escalations.title: Escalated requests
escalations.subtitle: Requests that waited longer than their stage allows. Open one to decide it in Approvals.
escalations.empty: No open escalations you can see.
